C-PLAN-COMPOSITION-371.Summary: Import multilevel plans, assist unresolved source rows with optional local LLM, and compose an editable monthly document from canonical events.
C-PLAN-COMPOSITION-371.Problem: Existing plans are isolated and DOCX generation reimports a new plan. Operators cannot collect selected events from several sources into a persistent monthly document without duplicating calendar obligations.

Goals.Goal: Process multiple files independently through existing immutable intake and expose exact created plans with targeted retry.
Provide bounded queued LLM proposals verified against source rows, without blocking deterministic import or overwriting manual facts.
Expose one ACL-filtered event projection and a saved monthly composition of references, ordering and document-only overrides.
Generate an editable DOCX snapshot using a reusable monthly sample or built-in format without creating new plan items or calendar entries.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: user request and issue 371. Exact main is 8d6ec438563fefc52077bcc9058234c72a841bf3; runtime version remains 0.4.12.
Only additive migration 032 for normalized monthly composition and export history; existing migrations, immutable sources, evidence and manual corrections remain intact.
Monthly records do not become a second task registry. Every source is checked under existing ACL before listing, adding and exporting; revoked access cannot reveal cached text.
LLM output is untrusted: bounded inputs, exact source quotes, validated structured response, deterministic date parsing, proposals only for unresolved rows, no arbitrary tools.
Core behavior works offline without LLM. One failed file, row or optional model request does not invalidate successful work.
Archive completed C-SEARCH-RELEASE-359 with terminal status only. Do not modify installer, auth model, dependencies or release infrastructure.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Release publication, arbitrary Word layout reconstruction, cloud parsing, automatic source-date shifting and execution of document instructions.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Multiple input files have truthful independent saved/processing/ready/failed states and exact navigation; retry does not duplicate persisted sources.
LLM validates identifiers, quotes and field provenance; malformed or unavailable responses degrade safely; source manual edits survive retries.
Methodological, teaching, science, organizational and everyday activity filters are derived labels over existing directions, not invented facts or automatic department exclusions.
Monthly composition survives reload, preserves order and overrides, and adds/removes references idempotently without changing source plan items or calendar counts.
DOCX includes selected effective fields and exact month, preserves uploaded OOXML sample formatting, records source/template versions and snapshot hash, and does not enter plan extraction.
Clean install, exact-base upgrade, repeated migrations, quick_check, foreign_key_check, backup verification, restore and forced-failure recovery pass.
Project CI plus focused integration and desktop/mobile browser scenarios pass, with actual limitations documented.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head project CI, risk-scoped database/recovery gate, focused browser scenarios and final GRACE scope lint. No real model or target Astra claim from fixture responses.
